# Tool wear and repair (generated by tools/tool_wear_sheet.py from the data)

Wear is counted in uses; a tool breaks at its durability. Repair needs the materials listed and gives back 50% of the durability.

| Tool | Class | Durability (wear points) | Uses before it breaks, by kind of work | Minutes of steady work | Repair materials | Where | Smith, fully worn (stranger) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Stone axe | axe | 900 | gather 900, rock 900, tree 900, trunk 900, split 900 | 30.0 | 1 stick, 1 cordage | by hand | 11 copper |
| Stone spear | weapon | 450 | use 450 | 15.0 | 1 stone, 1 cordage | by hand | 13 copper |
| Wooden spear | weapon | 300 | use 300 | 10.0 | 1 stick | by hand | 7 copper |
| Stone knife | knife | 540 | gather 540 | 18.0 | 1 stone, 1 cordage | by hand | 7 copper |
| Wooden spade | spade | 2025 | gather 2025, dig 2025 | 67.5 | 1 stick | by hand | 8 copper |
| Iron pickaxe | pick | 9000 | use 9000 | 300.0 | 1 iron ingot, 1 stick | a forge nearby | 63 copper |
| Steel pickaxe | pick | 22500 | use 22500 | 750.0 | 1 steel ingot, 1 stick | a forge nearby | 156 copper |
| Stone spade | spade | 4050 | gather 4050, dig 4050 | 135.0 | 1 stone, 1 cordage | by hand | 16 copper |
| Iron spade | spade | 20250 | gather 20250, dig 20250 | 675.0 | 1 iron ingot, 1 stick | a forge nearby | 47 copper |
| Steel spade | spade | 40500 | gather 40500, dig 40500 | 1350.0 | 1 steel ingot, 1 stick | a forge nearby | 73 copper |
| Sewing needle | needle | 270 | use 270 | 9.0 | 1 bone | by hand | 5 copper |
| Fishing rod | rod | 360 | use 360 | 12.0 | 1 cordage | by hand | 6 copper |

A smith (shops.json "repairs": true) mends any worn or broken tool as new for value x 0.40 x the share worn x the pay multiple. Minutes assume one use every 2 seconds.

Kinds of work: gather (a plant yield that needs the tool), rock (stone from an outcrop), tree (one blow on a standing tree), trunk (one blow on a felled trunk), split (one log at the chopping block). Weapons wear per throw or jab (placeholder: 1).
